subject: Re: SnowBridge co-sell / account demarcation request
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Anna Lee <anna@snowbridge.com>, procurement@snowbridge.com
Date: Tue, 29 Aug 2028 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: SnowBridge - account mapping request and material

Hi team,

Quick heads-up: SnowBridge has raised a conflict between our Field GTM (AMs) and Alliances on a set of mid-market accounts in the Northeast. They shared the attached MAT and an internal co-sell map that shows overlapping ownership for ~12 accounts (including Hxx Labs and Meridian Analytics).

Ask: can Alliances + Sales agree on a short demarcation (who owns which logos + any carve-outs) so we can avoid duplicate outreach and set expectations for lead routing? I think we should:
- Confirm primary owner per account
- Agree lead routing for inbound demo requests
- Lock a single contact at SnowBridge for deal coordination (they suggested Kevin Wu)

I've attached the co-sell-account-map.xlsx and the SnowBridge_MAT_v2.pdf that SnowBridge provided. They also flagged an open opportunity SB-ACQ-347 where both sides have pipeline.

Proposed next step: 30-min sync tomorrow to hammer out the demarcation and record it in our shared Drive. Jonas — can you pull a quick list of accounts you think Sales should retain based on current AM assignments?

Thanks,
Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Head of Alliances, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: SnowBridge_MAT_v2.pdf (application/pdf), co-sell-account-map.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>

Cc: Anna Lee <anna@snowbridge.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Aug 2028 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SnowBridge - account mapping request and material

Thanks Marissa — appreciate the flag.

Quick notes from the field:
- Opportunity SB-ACQ-347 is being worked by AMs in NYC; expected close Q4 and Sales has been running discovery for 3 weeks.
- Of the 12 accounts called out, 8 are in active AM territories (based on the October assignment sheet). The other 4 are prospects where Alliances has primary influence.

I agree on a short demarcation exercise. My suggestion:
1) Sales retains accounts with an active AM opportunity or a signed NDA (we have clear tags in CRM).
2) Alliances owns proof-of-concept and platform integrations for greenfield accounts or where SnowBridge is requesting partner-led workshops.
3) For the 12 contested accounts, we create a temporary split: Sales primary / Alliances support for any co-sell joint motions; we will revisit after SB-ACQ-347 closes.

I can carve out a proposed per-account owner list and push to the Drive by EOD. Happy to join a 30-min sync — propose 10:00am PT tomorrow.

Jonas

Thanks everyone — good alignment in the thread. Short summary and actions below.

Summary:
- Sales retains primary ownership for accounts with active AM opportunities (incl. SB-ACQ-347).
- Alliances will own integration-led motions and partner workshops on greenfield accounts.
- For the 12 contested accounts, Sales = primary; Alliances = partner enablement for two workshops during POC. Revisit in 30 days or after SB-ACQ-347 close.

Action items (owners / due):
- Jonas: Share per-account owner list + CRM tags exported to the shared Drive. Due: EOD Thu 8/31. (Drive: https://drive.redwood.com/Shared/Partners/SnowBridge/co-sell-map)
- Marissa: Draft a one-page mutual action plan email for SnowBridge capturing the workshop commitment and routing contacts. Due: Fri 9/1.
- Priyom: Hold a short carrier check with Procurement for the SOW language and escalate any problematic terms. Due: Mon 9/4.
- Anna / Kevin (SnowBridge): Confirm single Redwood contact per account and accept the proposed workshop cadence.

Marissa / Jonas — please hit reply-all when you upload the list and the MAP. If anything changes re: SB-ACQ-347 we escalate to me immediately.

-Hannah
